title: Losing Error Provenance in Pipelines
pattern: Collapsing distinct subsystem errors (e.g. database errors, HTTP timeouts, validation errors) into a flat common string or generic error within a composite workflow pipeline.
why_bad: It wipes out the provenance of the failure, making it impossible for caller logic to route recovery steps programmatically (e.g. retrying a transient HTTP error vs. rejecting a permanent validation error).
detection: Composite functions utilizing `?` operators where all subsystem errors are cast to `String` or a flat type-erased container without keeping variant identifiers.
source: *Domain Modeling made Functional* by Scott Wlaschin (p. 262-263); *Rust for Rustaceans* by Jon Gjengset (p. 137-138).
